notes.title: Massive Graphical Update - New Demo Live Now!
notes.content:
Although there haven't been frequent updates to the Steam page, the development of the game continues steadily and surely.

This is the state of the game during the last Steam update:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37761556/4326acf38b7984246931b6b9a1977ab0959bf623.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37761556/ca25a9e8b0f318e8e24c3db224d58a30d4c325b5.png[/img]

And this is how it looks like in the latest demo build:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37761556/bc832813b42067b1ad32073a5a3fc28f14123634.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37761556/e01a0ae28e3e9771517fa535cfd24ac71b582c8d.png[/img]

As you can see, there have been a lot of advancements in all areas:
[list]
[*]Updated roster of models
[*]Re-worked UI
[*]Improved lighting and terrain rendering
[*]Updated editor tools
[*]Bugfixes and stability improvements
[*]Performance improvements
[*]Plenty of quality-of-life touches like progress text during loading screens
[/list]

The marathon continues and I ain't done just yet. The vision for a truly great RTS is not wholly fleshed out just yet but it's undoubtedly taking steps to get there. Just make sure you've got EVERGLORY in your wishlist so you don't sleep on the final release. In the meanwhile, try out the new demo build and do let me know your feedback!
